event.description:
Come join us for our weekly Grand Archive Hobby League!

Every Friday, 7pm. $12 entry - 1 booster and 1 event pack for participation. A 3-0 record receives an additional 3 event packs, 2-1 or 2-0-1 records receive 2 additional event packs, any other record in top 4 receives 1 additional event pack.
